svg.title: Golden frog level 50: Silver top hat, monocle and open chest
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) Golden frog badge, level 50: golden frog in a polished silver tuxedo jacket with black lapels trimmed in silver and set with rubies, a silver-rimmed monocle with a clear lens on a silver chain, its ruby bow tie, a ruby brooch in a silver setting, a ruby sash with silver trim and a silver medallion, and a silver top hat with a ruby band, behind an open chest with silver trim, heaped with silver coins, an amethyst and a sapphire, with two little silver frogs, spilling silver coins.
